keyLimits.en: Per-property pricing starting at $15/property/month, plus a platform fee, for operators managing 1-50 listings.
Per-property pricing starting at $25/property/month, plus a platform fee, for operators managing 51-199 listings.

addOns.en: API Access, Devices, and Screen & Protect are optional paid add-ons.

cautions.en: The official pricing page does not publish numbers directly and routes visitors to sales; per-property rates and platform fee were found via third-party sources, not the vendor's own published figures, and should be reverified before publishing.
A separate legacy 'Premium' per-property pricing model exists in Hostfully's own help documentation, suggesting past pricing structure changes.

capabilities.en: Short-term rental property management software: reservations, channel management, and guest communication.
Built-in direct booking website/site generator to reduce reliance on OTAs like Airbnb and Booking.com.

limitations.en: Pricing is not transparently published on the official site; prospective customers must talk to sales to get an exact quote.
Per-property pricing plus a separate platform fee means monthly cost is not a single flat number and requires calculation based on portfolio size.

unknowns: Exact published price points were not confirmed directly on hostfully.com; the official FAQ page withholds numbers and routes to sales, so the $15/$25 per-property figures come from third-party review sites and need reverification.
The catalogue's alternativeCandidates list for hostfully contained no direct property-management competitors (only generic dev/no-code tools), so no in-catalogue alternatives could be selected.
